baseline.name: Presence bitmap for values 1..n
baseline.approach: Allocate n+1 markers, record valid values, then scan for the first missing marker.

archived.name: Cyclic placement in the input array
archived.space: O(1) auxiliary space; input is rearranged

why: The input slots themselves encode which positive values are present, so a separate presence array is unnecessary.
quantitative_comparison: The bitmap stores n+1 markers. The archived method keeps constant state and makes at most n successful value-placement swaps before a linear scan. Both have linear growth in work; the established advantage is auxiliary storage, not a measured speed factor.
tradeoffs: Rearranges the caller's array. A bitmap can preserve input order and is often easier to audit; valid indexing and the duplicate guard are essential in cyclic placement.
evidence_basis: Static source inspection and stated algorithm work/storage model. Comparator is an analytical alternative, not an implemented or timed benchmark. Historical platform acceptance is separate from current local validation.
